instruction: Calculate the total sum of all ages in the ODS spreadsheet using command line tools, and save the result to /home/user/Desktop/age_sum.txt

metadata.explanation: Task requires using command line to calculate sum of all ages (column F) from ODS file and save to text file. Expected value verified with Python: sum of 5000 ages = 166300. Evaluator reads the result file and checks if numeric value matches.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads file content from the specified path using cat command and handles missing files appropriately
Metric logic correctly extracts numeric value from string, compares against expected value 166300, and handles edge cases (empty result, non-numeric values)
Expected value parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses expected.get('value') which receives the rules dict {'value': 166300} from get_rule
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the numeric result in the saved file, which fully covers the instruction requirement
Expected value (166300) is semantically correct as the sum of 5000 ages from the ODS file
Postconfig appropriately kills gnome-terminal-server to clean up terminal state after task execution
